messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10993126/pdf/main.pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2024.109382

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Cell-Based Non-Invasive Diagnostic Testing Using the DISCO Platform -- Detergent Direct Capture (DDC) Reconstitution of the ABC Transporter MsbA in Peptidiscs and Malachite Green ATPase Activity Assay

REAGENTS USED:
  - MsbA-Enriched Membrane Extract (E. coli membrane fraction bearing His6-tagged MsbA)
  - DDM Detergent (n-dodecyl-beta-D-maltoside, 1% w/v solubilization solution)
  - Peptidisc Peptide (NSPr amphipathic peptide, molar excess)
  - Dilution Buffer (Buffer A: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.8, 100 mM NaCl, 10% glycerol)
  - Wash Buffer (Buffer A, used for Ni-NTA resin washing)
  - Elution Buffer (Buffer A + 600 mM Imidazole)
  - ATP Reagent (2 mM ATP in reaction buffer: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.8, 100 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2)
  - Malachite Green Reagent (Malachite green solution with 0.05% Triton X-100)

STEPS:
1. Solubilization: Solubilize the MsbA-enriched membrane extract with 1% DDM detergent for 30 min at 4 C to release MsbA from the native membrane.
2. Peptidisc reconstitution: Mix the clarified detergent extract with a molar excess of peptidisc peptide (NSPr) to initiate detergent-direct-capture reconstitution.
3. Dilution/concentration cycles: Rapidly dilute the mixture into fresh dilution buffer and concentrate over a filter; repeat this dilution/concentration cycle 3 times to progressively lower the detergent concentration to a calculated ~0.008% final level.
4. Resin binding and washing: Incubate the reconstituted mixture with Ni-NTA resin for 1 hour at 4 C, then wash the resin with wash buffer to remove unbound material.
5. Elution: Elute the peptidisc-reconstituted MsbA (DDC-MsbA) from the resin using elution buffer containing imidazole.
6. ATPase reaction: Combine the eluted peptidisc-MsbA with ATP reagent and incubate at 37 C for 10 min to allow ATP hydrolysis.
7. Colorimetric detection: Add Malachite green reagent to the reaction, incubate at room temperature for 10 min to allow color development, then measure light absorption at 660 nm to quantify the released inorganic phosphate and calculate the initial rate of ATP hydrolysis, then discard the analyzed reaction mixture.

INTERPRETATION: Successful peptidisc reconstitution and ATPase activity measurement is confirmed when the DDC-MsbA preparation shows comparable purity and yield to other reconstitution methods (SDS-PAGE), a distinct blue-native gel migration pattern reflecting captured endogenous lipid content, and an ATPase rate elevated 2- to 5-fold relative to detergent-solubilized MsbA (DDM-MsbA), consistent with the lipid-mediated increase in both thermal stability and ATPase activity described for peptidisc preparations with higher endogenous lipid content.

module fluorescence

manifest membrane_extract
manifest ddm_detergent
manifest peptidisc_peptide
manifest dilution_buffer
manifest wash_buffer
manifest elution_buffer
manifest atp_reagent
manifest malachite_green_reagent

instructions:

membrane = dispense membrane_extract
ddm = dispense ddm_detergent
extract = mix membrane with ddm for 1800s
heat extract at 4c for 30m

peptide = dispense peptidisc_peptide
recon = mix extract with peptide

repeat 3 times {
    buffer = dispense 15000 units of dilution_buffer
    recon = mix recon with buffer for 60s
}

wash = dispense wash_buffer
washed = mix recon with wash for 60s
heat washed at 4c for 60m
dispose washed

elution = dispense elution_buffer
peptidisc_msba = mix recon with elution

atp = dispense atp_reagent
reaction = mix peptidisc_msba with atp
heat reaction at 37c for 10m

mg_reagent = dispense malachite_green_reagent
detect_mix = mix reaction with mg_reagent
heat detect_mix at 25c for 10m

atpase_reading = detect fluorescence on detect_mix for 60s

dispose detect_mix

main:
	membrane1[0] = dispense(membrane_extract)
	ddm1[0] = dispense(ddm_detergent)
	extract1[0] = mix(membrane1[0], ddm1[0]) @ 1800.0SECOND
	heat(extract1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 1800.0SECOND
	peptide1[0] = dispense(peptidisc_peptide)
	recon1[0] = mix(extract1[0], peptide1[0])
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_31 = {REPEAT_30,REPEAT_32}
	PHI buffer1 = {buffer0,buffer2}
	PHI recon2 = {recon1,recon3}
	if REPEAT_31[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	buffer2[0] = dispense(dilution_buffer)
	recon3[0] = mix(recon2[0], buffer2[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	REPEAT_32[0] = REPEAT_31[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	wash1[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	washed1[0] = mix(recon2[0], wash1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(washed1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	dispose(washed1[0])
	elution1[0] = dispense(elution_buffer)
	peptidisc_msba1[0] = mix(recon2[0], elution1[0])
	atp1[0] = dispense(atp_reagent)
	reaction1[0] = mix(peptidisc_msba1[0], atp1[0])
	heat(reaction1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
	mg_reagent1[0] = dispense(malachite_green_reagent)
	detect_mix1[0] = mix(reaction1[0], mg_reagent1[0])
	heat(detect_mix1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
	atpase_reading1[0] = detect(fluorescence, detect_mix1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	dispose(detect_mix1[0])
	NOP

numeric_mismatches.note: Detection in the paper is a 660 nm absorbance measurement of the Malachite green-phosphate complex, converted to nmol Pi/mg protein/min via a phosphate standard curve, not a fluorogenic signal. 'detect fluorescence' is used only because it is the sole detect module exposed by BioScript's grammar.

numeric_mismatches.field: wash and Ni-NTA resin binding steps modeled with 'mix' and 'heat'
numeric_mismatches.note: BioScript has no primitive for resin-based affinity chromatography, sedimentation, or column washing; the 1 hour 4C Ni-NTA incubation and subsequent wash are approximated as a single mix/heat/dispose sequence rather than a multi-wash resin protocol.

numeric_mismatches.field: repeat 3 times dilution/concentration cycle volume (15000 units)
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper specifies a 15 mL dilution into Buffer A followed by ultrafiltration concentration to 500 uL per cycle; the exact ultrafiltration/concentration step has no BioScript primitive, so only the dilution volume is represented and the concentration step is omitted.

numeric_mismatches.field: ultracentrifugation steps (180000g clarification of detergent extract) and blue-native/SDS-PAGE analyses
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. BioScript has no centrifugation or gel-electrophoresis primitive; only the liquid-handling and incubation steps of the reconstitution and ATPase assay are captured.

numeric_mismatches.field: thermal stability assay (50C denaturation time course), lipidomic LC-MS/MS analysis, SecYEG reconstitution and SecA binding/ATPase assays, and exogenous PG/CL lipid-addition experiments
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. These are separate structural, lipidomic, and comparative functional sub-experiments performed alongside the core DDC-MsbA reconstitution and ATPase assay, and fall outside the scope of this translation; only the DDC reconstitution and Malachite green ATPase workflow (STAR Methods) is captured here.
